title: UX research-plan drafting
whenToUse: Structure a real research plan the human will execute.
whenNotToUse: Asking the model to invent study results.
promptTemplate:
GOAL:
Draft research plan for {{question}}.

CONTEXT:
Constraints: {{constraints}}.

INPUT:
Decisions to inform: {{decisions}}

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do not invent findings
- Methods must match question

OUTPUT:
Participants, script outline, analysis plan

ACCEPTANCE:
Human can run sessions from the plan.

VERIFICATION:
Success criteria for research quality—not product outcome claims.
improvedPrompt: Plan 5 usability tests for save-invoice; do not invent results; include script and notes grid.
